item.title: Recent DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Projects
item.description: This portfolio highlights recent hands-on projects including a GitOps deployment pipeline on AKS, a Terraform-codified AWS serverless CI/CD architecture, and an EKS-based e-commerce platform, showcasing expertise in modern DevOps and cloud infrastructure.

item.title: Secure CI/CD: Decoupling IaC and Application Pipelines
item.description: This article outlines a secure and efficient architectural approach for CI/CD pipelines, advocating for the strict decoupling of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) provisioning using Terraform from application build processes. It details how separating these lifecycles enhances security, reduces blast radius, and optimizes execution speed.

item.title: Secure CI/CD: Decoupling IaC from Application Builds
item.description: This article details a critical best practice for CI/CD pipelines: strictly decoupling Infrastructure as Code (IaC) from application builds. It explains how this approach enhances security by enforcing least privilege and improves efficiency, outlining a secure architecture using separate pipelines for infrastructure provisioning and application delivery with GitOps.

item.title: Building a GitOps Microservices Architecture on AWS
item.description: This project details the implementation of an end-to-end DevOps Microservices architecture on AWS, leveraging a GitOps workflow with Terraform, AWS EKS, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD. It highlights key challenges encountered during deployment and their practical solutions.

item.title: Building a Cloud and DevOps Portfolio
item.description: This portfolio showcases hands-on experience in provisioning AWS infrastructure with Terraform, establishing automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, and deploying 3-tier applications on Azure Kubernetes Service.

item.title: Voting Application CD with GitOps and ArgoCD
item.description: Implemented a continuous deployment pipeline for a Voting Application, leveraging GitOps and ArgoCD to deploy Docker images from Azure Container Registry to an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster.
